name: ferry
trans: n. a boat that transports people or vehicles across a body of water and operates on a regular schedule

name: boat
trans: n. a small vessel for travel on water

name: ship
trans: n. a vessel that carries passengers or freight

name: steam ship
trans: n. 汽船；轮船

name: harbor
trans: n. a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo

name: fly
trans: v. travel through the air; be airborne; move quickly or suddenly

name: airport
trans: n. an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo

name: terminal
trans: n. station where transport vehicles load or unload passengers or goods

name: train
trans: n. public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

name: tram
trans: n. a conveyance that transports passengers or freight in carriers suspended from cables and supported by a series of towers

name: coach
trans: n. (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team

name: minibus
trans: n. a light bus (4 to 10 passengers)

name: attraction
trans: n. the force by which one object attracts another; an entertainment that is offered to the public

name: places of interest
trans: n. 名胜古迹

name: theme park
trans: n. an amusement park that is organized around some theme (as the world of tomorrow)

name: campsite
trans: n. a site where people on holiday can pitch a tent

name: castle
trans: n. a large and stately mansion; a large building formerly occupied by a ruler and fortified against attack

name: desert
trans: n. arid land with little or no vegetation

name: mountain
trans: n. a land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill

name: forest
trans: n. the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area; land that is covered with trees and shrubs

name: lake
trans: n. a body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land

name: waterfall
trans: n. a steep descent of the water of a river

name: botanic garden
trans: n. 植物园

name: sea
trans: n. a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land; anything apparently limitless in quantity or volume

name: ocean
trans: n. a large body of water constituting a principal part of the hydrosphere

name: coast
trans: n. the shore of a sea or ocean

name: beach
trans: n. an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake

name: island/isle
trans: n. 岛，岛屿

name: museum
trans: n. a depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value

name: gallery
trans: n. spectators at a golf or tennis match

name: sculpture
trans: n. a three-dimensional work of plastic art; creating figures or designs in three dimensions

name: heritage site
trans: n. 遗址(景区）

name: adventure playground
trans: n. 儿童游乐园

name: circus
trans: n. a travelling company of entertainers; including trained animals; a performance given by a traveling company of acrobats, clowns, and trained animals

name: whale watch
trans: n. phrase 看鲸

name: bush walking
trans: n. 在丛林中徒步

name: trekking
trans: v. journey on foot, especially in the mountains

name: hiking
trans: n. a long walk usually for exercise or pleasure

name: fishing
trans: n. the act of someone who fishes as a diversion

name: kite surfing
trans: n. 风筝冲浪

name: surfing
trans: n. the sport of riding a surfboard toward the shore on the crest of a wave

name: water skiing
trans: v. ride water skis

name: scuba diving
trans: n. skin diving with scuba apparatus

name: sunbathe
trans: v. expose one's body to the sun

name: skiing
trans: n. a sport in which participants must travel on skis

name: recreation
trans: n. an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates
